name: Cocina 35
notes: Official site cocina35.com/cocina-menu/ has a full dish list with descriptions but NO prices at all. Toast online ordering page (linked from the site's Order Online button) has the full priced menu, ~97 items across 8 sections. Uber Eats also lists it.

name: Jersey Mike's Subs
notes: National chain page. Store is #20313, 6030 Village Way (The Village at Pacific Highlands Ranch). Prices ARE shown but baked into the product IMAGES (e.g. 'Regular $8.95') - get_page_text returns zero prices, only a screenshot reveals them. Uber Eats store page (ubereats.com/store/jersey-mikes-subs-6030-village-way/ZP4iuY25SjaaznLEHGoDEA) has the same menu with prices as real text.

name: Carmelita's
notes: Neighborhood label 'Julian' is wrong - lat/lng 33.2555,-116.3808 is 575 Palm Canyon Dr, Borrego Springs (Carmelita's Mexican Grill and Cantina), ~18 mi from Julian. No official website exists. RestaurantGuru carries a full owner-uploaded menu with prices, ~79 items. zmenu.com also has one but is behind a Cloudflare bot check.

name: Casa de Freds
notes: WARNING - HIJACKED DOMAIN: the location site www.fredsmexicancafeoldtown.com (linked from the legit parent fredsmexicancafe.com) now 302s to da3q0p0hubcc73842t90.datasyncpit.co.in, a 'Click Allow to confirm you are not a robot' push-notification scam. Left without clicking. Parent site fredsmexicancafe.com is clean but is just a 3-location splash page with no menu. Toast (order.toasttab.com/online/freds-mexican-cafe) exists but returned 'online ordering unavailable' / 'menu items unavailable' on both toasttab and toast.app. RestaurantGuru has a full owner-uploaded menu with prices (~110 items incl. food, cocktails, happy hour, dog menu).

name: Humphreys SoCal Dining & Music
notes: Menu lives on the parent hotel's site (Humphreys Half Moon Inn). Plain HTML, tabbed by menu (Breakfast, Dinner, Young Ladies & Gentlemen, Oasis Pool Bar), every item priced including a large wine/beer/cocktail list. Very large: ~190 line items, roughly half of them drinks. humphreysrestaurant.com also resolves and links here.

name: Habaneros
notes: Reverse-geocoded to 6785 Mira Mesa Blvd #145, San Diego 92121 (Habanero's Mexican Grill) - 'Sorrento Valley' label is approximate. No standalone website; their Toast-hosted site habanerosmexicangrill.toast.site is broken (404, 'a shortUrl is missing for this page'). The Toast ordering page works and carries a very large fully priced menu (~200 line items incl. food, drinks, catering, mariscos).

name: Buka - Taste of Nigeria
notes: No official website exists (searched several ways; Yelp's "see this menu on Buka's site" link is dead). 3727 University Ave, aka Buka Nigerian Restaurant and Lounge. BeyondMenu has a fully priced ~52-item menu though the store is flagged "not accepting online orders". Yelp also has a priced menu at yelp.com/menu/buka-restaurant-taste-of-nigeria-san-diego but it is labelled "archived".

name: Las Olas
notes: Official domain lasolasmex.com resolves but the Wix site is UNPUBLISHED - it serves only "Private Site / This site is currently private". Allmenus (Grubhub) has a full priced ~75-item menu, but the prices are clearly stale (breakfast burrito $8.50, carne asada platter $18.50) and the page footer is (c)2023. A staleness caveat matters more than availability here.

name: Humberto's Taco Shop
notes: 1015 25th St (Broadway/Sherman Heights edge of Golden Hill). No real official website - humbertos-taco-shop.website looks official in search results but is an AI-generated SEO scraper page with zero prices. DoorDash has the store with prices (featured items visible without an address); RestaurantGuru mirrors a full owner-uploaded ~85-item priced menu updated a month ago (restaurantguru.com/Humbertos-San-Diego/menu) and is the easier one to parse.

name: Medina
notes: Full name Medina Moroccan-Baja Kitchen, 2850 El Cajon Blvd #4 (nominatim says North Park, not Normal Heights). No official website of any kind - no domain found. Allmenus/Grubhub has a fully priced menu but it is TINY: 16 items total (3 bowls, 3 tacos, 4 sides, 1 dessert, 5 drinks). RestaurantGuru has a newer owner-uploaded menu (5 months old) but only as photographs, not text. Good tail data point for how small these menus get.
